policyBoundary: The local full SR2026 Message Reference Guides govern the base message profile; an applicable Usage Guideline or bilateral policy may only narrow it.
MRG field eligibility does not prove that a bank-specific value is SSI-resolvable; eligible Own or Counterparty SSI evidence remains required.
86a is explicitly deferred from Phase 1 and is not present in the FIN field resolver catalogue.

fields.selectionPolicy: Option A when BIC-identifiable; Option D only for name/address or controlled bilateral exception with a reason code
